reasons: CS2103T requires CS2040 (or equivalent) which is not in the required list and has prerequisites (CS1010 etc) not yet completed or planned. CS2040S requires CS1231 which is not completed. Without CS2040/CS2040S, CS2103T, CS3219, CS3227, CS3230, CS3281, CS2109S, and CS4261 cannot be taken as their prerequisites depend on Data Structures/Algorithms modules not listed as required or completed.

CS4261 requires CS2040 (or equivalent) and a probability course (EE2012/ST2131/MA2116 etc) which are not in the required list. CS2109S requires CS2040 (or equivalent). These core prerequisites are missing from the student's plan.

The student's required list omits the foundational Data Structures and Algorithms module (e.g., CS2040, CS2040S) and Probability module required for the advanced electives listed (CS2109S, CS3230, CS4261). Without these, the plan is impossible.
